title: MLINE referenced complex-text LTYPE and STYLE provider

authority.title: Autodesk LTYPE DXF reference
authority.used_for: Group 74 text flag; groups 75, 340, 46, 50, 44, 45 and 9 meanings.

authority.title: Autodesk STYLE DXF reference
authority.used_for: STYLE provider table-record fields and identity.

scope.source: Runtime-generated MLINE authority recipe with a text-bearing complex LTYPE and a complete STYLE table record; no external fixture is used.
scope.cross_product: Both source encodings were exported to both output encodings.
scope.linetype: EditDash, one dash of 1.5, flags 2, shape number 0, text DXF, scale 0.75, rotation 0.25 radians on the wire, offsets 0.125/-0.25.
scope.style_provider: ComplexText at source handle 1F3; the LTYPE group-340 points to this source provider.
scope.consumer: The MLINESTYLE references EditDash; source MLINE consumers remain unchanged.

proof.source: Physical source projection verifies every selected LTYPE field and the STYLE provider handle before import; the model binds the segment style handle to the parsed STYLE provider.
proof.output: Physical output verifies that group 340 equals the emitted STYLE record handle; a fresh read confirms the remapped handle and text-segment values, while the MLINESTYLE consumers remain valid.
proof.failure_retry: Removing the required STYLE provider from the caller model causes export refusal and preserves the destination sentinel. Restoring the provider allows a successful same-adapter retry.

limits: This qualifies transport and source/output identity for one AC1027 text-bearing LTYPE profile only; it does not prove the font is installed or that text renders correctly.
Shape-bearing segments, other complex flags, multiple segments, optional-field placements, other providers, versions, native rendering, and composed document closure remain open.
